treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Armenia and the Kingdom of Denmark for the elimination of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and the prevention of tax evasion and avoidance (2018)
eif_quote: [DK list] DBO | 14.03.2018 | L 31/2018 ... | BKI nr. 5 af 22.06.2020 | 22.10.2019 | Virkning 01.01.2020 | MLI Indmeldt af Danmark || [AM MLI position] ...d on Capita Kingdom of Denmark Original 14-03-2018 22-10-2019
source_title: AM-DK Convention, English text (scanned PDF DENMARK_DoubleTaxationTreaty_EN, Armenian MoF archive), pages read visually

rates.quote: a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 50 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends and has invested more than 2 million Euros, or its equivalent in Armenian or Danish currency, in the capital of the company paying the dividends at the date of payment of the dividends;

c) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends and has invested more than 100,000 Euros, or its equivalent in Armenian or Danish currency, in the capital of the company paying the dividends at the date of payment of the dividends;
d) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
c) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest in all other cases.
a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties, in the case of payments of the kind referred to in sub-paragraphs a) and b) of paragraph 3;

ppt.quote: 4. Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Dividend 0% tier (>=50%) also requires investment > EUR 2 million, 5% tier (>=10%) requires investment > EUR 100,000, at the payment date. Art. 10(2)(b): 0% where beneficial owner is the other State, its Central Bank or a government-owned agency/financial institution (not modelled). Interest: 0% if paid to a State/local authority/Central Bank or government-owned institution (11(2)(a)); 5% on loans granted by a banking enterprise (11(2)(b)) - not modelled. Royalties: 5% for software, patents, trade marks, designs, models, plans, secret formulas and know-how (para 3(a)-(b)) - recorded; 10% for copyright of literary/artistic/scientific works incl. films (para 3(c)) - not modelled. Art. 29(1)-(3) LOB: notwithstanding Arts. 11 and 12, interest and royalties may be taxed under domestic law if not subject to tax or subject to a preferential foreign-income regime in the residence State. Art. 30: WHT on amounts payable on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2019-10-22 -> 2020-01-01). The treaty map lists the pair as MLI-covered with WHT effect 2024-01-01, but no MLI synthesised text was found in the Armenian MoF archive; the treaty already contains a PPT (Art. 29(4)).
unverified: whether the MLI modifies this treaty (no synthesised text located; treaty map says MLI-covered from 2024-01-01)
